Subject: Observability add-ons quote (retention + tracing)

Hi Rishi,

Thanks again for the demo yesterday. We loved the dashboard previews — observability will be a big help for our ML infra team. Finance asked me to get a formal quote for the observability add-ons specifically:

- Log/trace retention tiers (30 / 90 / 365 days)
- Distributed tracing events (monthly volume tiers)
- Advanced dashboards (per-seat or account-level pricing?)

We're targeting a mid-June procurement decision. Our expected baseline usage (rough estimate) is ~2 TB/month of storage equivalent and ~150M trace events/month, and we'd like to know: pricing table, volume discounts, whether you offer a committed-spend discount, and what SLAs (retention durability, ingestion latency) apply for retained telemetry.

Can you share a one-page proposal and any attachments for internal review? Also copy our contracts team (contracts@olivetech.com).

Best,
Sara
Sara Morgan
Senior Platform Ops
Olive Tech

Subject: Re: Observability add-ons quote (retention + tracing)

Sara — thanks for the detailed ask and for looping in contracts. Attached is a concise proposal that maps your usage estimate to our three retention tiers and tracing volume bands. High level:

- Retention tiers: 30d (included baseline), 90d (+$0.10/GB-mo), 365d (+$0.25/GB-mo)
- Tracing: up to 100M events/mo: $0.02/event; 100–500M: $0.015/event; >500M: custom pricing
- Advanced dashboards: $40/seat/mo or $2,400/account/mo (up to 10 seats) - we can model either depending on your seat count

I've attached: RI_Observability_Addons_Proposal_v1.pdf and a usage_breakdown_olivetech.xlsx with cost estimates based on your 2TB/150M numbers. Preliminary total (no discounts): ~$8.7k/mo on the 90d retention + middle tracing band + 5 dashboard seats.

Commercial notes: we typically offer tiered discounts tied to 12-mo committed spend. For a 12-mo commit at $75k ARR we can provide a 10% discount; 25% discount requires an approved reserved-capacity / committed capacity agreement (Dedicated or Annual Add-on Commitment).

Next steps: 1) Contracts review scope (Sara / contracts) 2) Confirm seat vs account pricing for dashboards 3) Decide on 12-mo commit level for discounting and I'll loop in Aditya for final pricing approval.

Thanks — happy to hop on a 30-min call if it helps.

—Rishi

Sara — looping in finance and SE to address your bullets. Quick responses:

1) 20% discount: possible but it depends on the commitment profile. For a 12-mo, $75k ARR commit we can offer 15% off list; to reach 20% we typically need either a 24-mo committed spend or a token reserved capacity purchase (we can fold that into the contract). We can create a blended model: 15% off service fees + one-time onboarding credit to get to ~20% economic impact.

2) Tracing pricing: per-event price is for ingestion/indexing and primary analytics; retention storage fees for >90d are billed by GB-month (covered in the retention line items). There are no separate egress fees for dashboards within the same account region.

3) Dashboards: at 12 seats the account-level cap ($2,400/mo) is already cheaper than 12 * $40 = $480. Looks like account-level is the better option. We'll mark that in the proposal.

Aditya — can you review the suggested discount paths and confirm if a blended 15% + onboarding credit is approvable without exec sign-off?

Thanks,
Laura

Sara — quick technical clarifications to include in the proposal/SOW:

- Tracing: ingestion price covers sampling, indexing, and queryable retention for the purchased retention tier. Long-term retention (365d) uses cold storage with slightly higher retrieval latency for deep historical searches.
- Storage math: 2TB/mo raw translates to ~2.2 TB stored after indexing; the proposal model uses GB-month on stored size.
- Dashboards: account-level cap includes shared dashboards + up to 15 scheduled reports; additional seats beyond 10 are $35/seat/mo.
- SLA: retention durability 99.99% for primary storage; ingestion latency SLA for telemetry ingestion is 2s p50, 5s p95 for hosted deployments (we can provide Dedicated SLA language separately).

Next steps I suggest: 1) Rishi to share revised proposal with blended pricing (15% + $5k credit) and updated SOW language, 2) Sara to confirm term length and billing cadence, 3) Contracts to review NDA & procurement addendum. I'll be on standby for a 30-min technical follow-up if needed.

Thanks — Priyom
Solutions Engineering, Redwood Inference
